$comment: Single source of truth for the public, indexable pages.
This is JSON rather than TypeScript on purpose: it is consumed both by
the app (src/constants/seo.ts imports it, typed) and by build scripts
scripts/prerender.mjs). JSON is the only format both read without a
TypeScript runtime or a brittle regex parse of a .ts file.
Adding a public page means adding it here — then the sitemap, the
prerender step and the page metadata all pick it up, and the build
fails if the router doesn't actually serve it.
`aliases` are extra paths that render the same page. They get static
HTML (so an inbound link to /legal works) but are NOT listed in the
sitemap, because each one declares the canonical path instead.
